name: Evans Gambit — Main Line
description: White sacrifices a pawn on b4 for rapid development and central dominance — the most aggressive Italian continuation.

lines.name: Evans Gambit (4.b4)
lines.description: White offers the b4 pawn for rapid development. Black accepts with Bxb4, White pushes c3 to chase the bishop, then d4 to claim the center. White castles on move 7 before recapturing with cxd4.
